name: PFI Inc. - PCBA Electronic Assembly Equipment
about:
PFI Inc. operates from Longwood, Florida, as a distributor of surface-mount technology (SMT) and printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) equipment. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm supplies a broad range of equipment categories including pick-and-place machines, automated optical inspection (AOI) and solder paste inspection (SPI) systems, aqueous and batch cleaning systems, conformal coating equipment, reflow ovens, wave and selective soldering machines, depaneling routers, screen printers, and test equipment such as in-circuit and flying-probe testers. It also stocks feeder carts and feeders for major placement platforms from Myronic, Juki, Europlacer, Panasonic, Fuji, ASM, Universal Instruments, and Yamaha. In addition to equipment sales, PFI maintains an in-house service technician team and a logistics department that coordinates shipping.

Customers are electronics manufacturers and contract assemblers requiring SMT and through-hole assembly machinery. The inventory includes both new and used units, such as a 2023 Aqueous Technologies Trident ZDO cleaner, a 2023 Essemtec PUMA2 pick-and-place system with feeder package, a 2016 OSAI Automation Neo router with dust extraction and chiller, and 2017–2018 Electrovert/ITW Aquastorm inline and batch washers.

The company emphasizes its in-house technical support and logistics capabilities as differentiators, offering economical shipping options and secure payment via major credit cards and PayPal.
